title: Horses: Short Word Adventure
subject: Reading
learning_objective: Read and understand short, concrete sentences with familiar vocabulary.
instructions: Read each short sentence. Then answer who and what.

story_content.opening: Sunny the Horse trots along a dusty trail. She wants to reach the apple tree.
story_content.passage: Sunny sees ripe apples on a low branch. She takes two careful steps. A bird sings from the fence. Sunny reaches an apple and munches happily. Then she trots home along the trail.
story_content.ending: Great work exploring horses ideas today!
